observation: Baseline with d_min=0.05. Only 9 months fit, MAPE=0.5391. Very poor out-of-sample R²=-3.71. Core issue appears to be preprocessing — only 9 months used from a 30+ year well.

description: d_min=0.03 — production from 2015-2025 declines only ~12% over 10 years. Lowering d_min to fit flat tail.
observation: No change. d_min has no effect because only 9 months are being fit — the decline curve never reaches terminal decline in such a short window. Problem is in preprocessing, not fitting.

description: significance_threshold=0.30 — lower threshold to merge phases
observation: No change. Significance threshold alone doesn't affect phase merging enough for this well with widely separated rework events.

description: peak_merge_distance=8 — merge rework phases for longer fit window
observation: MAPE improved 0.5391→0.3427. Fit months jumped 9→43. Merging nearby peaks combined multiple short phases into one longer fitting window. R² still negative but much better. Key breakthrough was preprocessing, not fitting.
